measurements.name: Monsoon Current
measurements.range_interpretation: One approximate author description for this feature definition. Not a range endpoint, annual extrema or confidence interval.
measurements.geographic_scope: Northward Southwest Monsoon Current around 8 N in the southern Bay of Bengal during July 2016. Existing eastward Sri Lanka route is a different regional reach.
measurements.section_orientation: Study analyzes east–west sections at 8 N across northward flow; exact paired width endpoints not extracted.
measurements.layer: Near-surface northward flow; no fixed numerical depth slice or depth interval supplied for the width.
measurements.time_convention: July 2016 campaign description; width observation days and repeated width measurements not extracted.
measurements.boundary_rule: Author-reported approximate surface breadth in the July 2016 observational/model study. No paired edge coordinates or numerical velocity cutoff extracted.
measurements.source_citation: Webber, Matthews, Vinayachandran, Neema, Sanchez-Franks, Vijith, Amol and Baranowski (2018), The Dynamics of the Southwest Monsoon Current in 2016 from High-Resolution In Situ Observations and Models, JPO 48, 2259–2282, doi:10.1175/JPO-D-17-0215.1.
measurements.source_locator: Original PDF p8 / printed p2266, section 3c; pp20–21 / printed pp2278–2279 discussion.
measurements.extraction_method: Approximate numerical description transcribed from visually inspected original prose, retaining its conditionality and feature definition. No width boundary digitization.
measurements.source_quality_note: Original paper inspected. Distinct local feature definitions, not a whole-current width or a continuous-versus-eddy separation.

Distinct from the other component, not a pooled width range, annual extrema or an occupied current footprint. Numerical uncertainty and paired edges unresolved.
original_regional_context.display_caption: Approximately 300 km · July 2016 surface-flow breadth. Observed northward near-surface flow includes recirculation. Separate feature definitions; no 150–300 km range. Numerical uncertainty unknown.
original_regional_context.display_method_note: Author-reported approximate surface breadth in the July 2016 observational/model study. No paired edge coordinates or numerical velocity cutoff extracted. July 2016 study context; no extracted monthly width series. Earlier 100–200 km scaling assumptions, ±4 Sv transport uncertainty and the 110 m NEMO display depth do not establish width support or error.
